comparisons.peer_topic: General business overview and technology focus
comparisons.peer_summary: AMD is a high-performance and adaptive computing leader driving innovation through technology, software, and product leadership to power data centers and AI.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and AMD describe their core business as providing comprehensive computing solutions across multiple market segments including data centers, AI, PCs, and edge computing. Intel frames this around its central x86 ecosystem strategy, stating it serves 'an increasingly smart and connected world' with end-to-end solutions. AMD similarly defines itself as a leader in 'adaptive computing' powering 'data centers' and 'AI' through high-performance technologies. Both disclosures emphasize a broad technological portfolio aimed at solving significant computing challenges across the entire infrastructure spectrum.

sentences.text: Our product offerings provide end-to-end solutions, scaling from data center to network, PCs, edge computing, and the emerging fields of AI and autonomous driving, to serve an increasingly smart and connected world.
At our core is the x86 ecosystem, which has served as a foundation of modern computing for over four decades.
AMD is the high performance and adaptive computing leader, powering the products and services that help solve the world's most important challenges.

Our technologies advance the future of data centers, powering the cloud services that have become an essential part of how we work, game, and connect to network, PCs, edge computing, and artificial intelligence (AI).

comparisons.peer_summary: The company's strategy focuses on technology leadership in semiconductor and infrastructure software solutions, achieved through strategic acquisitions and internal R&D to maintain market leadership and drive diversified financial results.
comparisons.comparison: Intel and Broadcom both position their strategies around achieving 'technology leadership' to serve leading global customers in infrastructure and computing markets. Intel achieves this by advancing its x86 ecosystem for performance and efficiency across diverse segments. Broadcom achieves similar technology leadership through 'strategic acquisitions' and 'internal research and development' to provide a 'comprehensive suite' of semiconductor and software solutions. While Intel focuses on evolving a long-standing architectural ecosystem, Broadcom focuses on acquiring and integrating diverse technologies to maintain leadership, yet both target the same high-value infrastructure and business customer base.

sentences.text: We continue to advance this ecosystem with x86 microarchitectures focused on performance and efficiency.

Our strategy is focused on technology leadership and category-leading semiconductor and infrastructure software solutions delivering a comprehensive suite of innovative infrastructure technology products to the world's leading business and government customers.

We seek to achieve this through strategic acquisitions of businesses and technologies, as well as extensive internal research and development, to ensure our products retain their technology market leadership.
